objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First thing I need you to do is to make absolutely sure that the type A locker inside the washroom is unlocked. And then, ensure that the type A locker within the washroom is open. And then, recover the latchkey from the type A locker inside the washroom. After that, make an effort to go east. And then, make absolutely sure the box within the vault is locked. And if you do that, you're the winner!

quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First of all, check that the type A locker is unlocked with the type A latchkey. And then, ensure that the type A locker inside the washroom is open. And then, recover the latchkey from the type A locker inside the washroom. After getting the latchkey, head east. With that accomplished, lock the box in the vault. And if you do that, you're the winner!
commands: unlock type A locker with type A latchkey
take latchkey from type A locker
